thread:
sam (People Ops): Quick idea: midseason "Thank-you Station" popups as a rolling program across 5 offices. Purpose: make it super easy to drop a spot-award card + small treat on the spot. Need schedule, supply list, QR nomination integration, and budget signoff. Spreadsheet w/office dates: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

mino (Ops): Love it. Proposed cadence: 1 week per office, rotating Mon-Fri. Which offices? SF, NYC, LON, SEA, TOR.

tara (Design): I can do a modular backdrop + two tabletop signs with QR for nominations. QR links to short nomination form; will provide print-ready PDFs.

eli (Facilities): We need footprint per station: 6ft table + 1 tall sign. Also power for tablet if we want on-site nomination kiosk. Building managers need heads-up.

sam (People Ops): Simple station flow: 1) quick blurb sign 2) box of pre-printed spot-award cards 3) small treats (individually wrapped) 4) sticker sheet 5) scan QR to nominate. Volunteers to staff during lunch windows.

nora (Finance): Ballpark budget ask? estimate per-office: signage $60, treats $45, cards/stickers $20, staff coffee/snacks $15 => ~$140/office excluding staffing. Approve up to $800 total from culture fund. Need receipts + vendor info coded to GL 4-215.

mino (Ops): Suppliers: local bakery for individually wrapped mini cookies, sticker print shop, and a print shop for signs. I can source and compare pricing by Tue.

tara (Design): I'll hand off art files by Mon. Can we do one template across offices to save $$?

sam (People Ops): Yes template only. Also want to randomly insert 10 $5 spot-award tokens into station boxes across the program for surprise rewards. Need tracking to redeem via People Ops.

nomination-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Draft nomination form + QR by Mon". :page_facing_up:

eli (Facilities): Logistics note: LON needs advance notice for lobby access; SF and NYC OK. I'll ping building teams today. Also need storage for signs between weeks.

nora (Finance): Add small compliance line on internal packing slip: "GL 4-215; retain receipts for audit". Also ask vendors for W-9 or tax ID for PO.

sam (People Ops): Volunteer ask: 2 people per lunch shift to staff table (11:30-1:30). Who can help for SF week (wk of May 17)? @here

mino (Ops): I'll cover SF Tue-Thu lunch shifts. Can get a temp for Mon.

tara (Design): I can do an in-person drop and staffing on Wed SF lunch.

sam (People Ops): Great. Final checklist I need before we lock dates: vendor quotes in sheet, QR url, volunteer roster, and final packing list. Draft packing list below: 
```
- 1 x tabletop sign (QR + blurb)
- 1 x tall backdrop sign
- 50 x spot-award cards (blank)
- 10 x $5 surprise tokens (randomly inserted)
- 2 x sticker sheets
- 60 x individually wrapped treats
- 1 x tablet (optional) with charger
- 1 x small waste bin
- 1 x volunteer sign-in sheet
```

sam (People Ops): I'll update the sheet with supplier contacts and a tentative calendar by EOD. If final cost >$800 we'll escalate to Nora for approval. Thanks team 49b

nora (Finance): Sounds good. Please cc finance@redwood.com when you upload quotes so we can PO fast.

sam (People Ops): Will do. Closing note: let's keep messaging low-bureaucracy and encourage folks to nominate on the spot. Goal: make recognition habitual. :sparkles:
